name: GA Cubers Big Blind Qualifier 2023

venue.name: Private Residence
venue.details: Exact address will be emailed to registered competitors before the competition

information:
This competition is a special competition with **only 4x4 Blindfolded, 5x5 Blindfolded, and 3x3 Multi-Blindfolded**; we will not be holding any other events. If you are a first-time competitor and are interested in competed in regular events like 3x3, you may want to look into [Fountain City 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FountainCity2023).

Only one guest per competitor is permitted. Please consider coming without a guest if possible as spectator seating will be limited due to the competition being held at a private residence.

If you are planning to attempt 20 or more cubes in 3x3 Multi-Blindfolded, please contact the organizers ahead of time so we can plan to accommodate your attempt logistically.
